messages:
kevin: CS reported a new user who copied the JS quickstart and only saw `Error: Bad request`. Go/Python surfaced `InvalidArgument` + hint. We need a short fix.
tara: Yeah, onboarding hit. Quick fix: update quickstart snippets and make JS SDK emit typed errors with `code` and `human_message` props.
lee: JS SDK currently sets Error.message = body.message || statusText. I'll add Error subclasses (InvalidArgumentError, RateLimitError, ServerError) and attach normalized fields: `code`, `human_message`, `hint`, `retry_after`, `http_status`.
alex: Streaming caveat: sometimes socket closes with only a status. Propose `x-rw-error: 1` header + final newline-delimited JSON trailer when available; SDKs fall back to status->code mapping.
kevin: For docs, let's publish a tiny mapping table and a one-paragraph migration note for quickstart. Mapping: 400=InvalidArgument, 401=AuthenticationFailed, 403=PermissionDenied, 404=ResourceNotFound, 409=Conflict, 422=InvalidState, 429=RateLimit (with retry_after seconds), 5xx=ServerError.
tara: Add a small compatibility shim in JS that converts legacy `{message}` bodies into the canonical envelope for one release and logs a deprecation warning.
lee: I'll include unit tests and an integration sampleapp CI test that POSTS an oversized prompt and asserts `err.code === 'InvalidArgument' && typeof err.human_message === 'string'`. PR ETA: tomorrow EOD.
alex: I'll draft the streaming trailer note and ensure server side sanitizes `human_message` (<=140 chars, no stacks).
support-bot: Created GH issue RW-ERR-9001 "JS SDK error classes + quickstart parity" assigned to lee. https://github.com/redwood/devex/issues/9001
kevin: Great. Once PRs merge, CS will re-check the affected tickets and we can remove the compat shim after one major release. Thanks all.
